info.name: Loops OpenAPI Spec API key Uploads API

items.docs: Request a pre-signed URL to upload an image asset. Upload the file with an HTTP `PUT` to the returned `presignedUrl` (sending the same `Content-Type` and `Content-Length`), then call `/uploads/{id}/complete` to finalize the asset.

params.name: id
params.description: The `emailAssetId` returned when the upload was created.

items.docs: Finalize an asset after the file has been uploaded to the pre-signed URL. Returns the public URL of the uploaded asset.
